from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("The Root Problem: Filtering Coefficients", [
            "Challenge: Summing every k-th coefficient of P(x).",
            "Use roots of unity as a filter.",
            "Roots vanish when powers aren't multiples of k."
        ])
        
        # Coefficients representation
        coeffs = VGroup(*[Text(f"a_{i}", font_size=24) for i in range(8)])
        coeffs.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3)
        self.place_in_area(coeffs, "B2", "B6")
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display coefficient sequence on screen. (#FFFFFF)
        self.play(FadeIn(coeffs))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFFFFF")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight every k-th coefficient using flashing effect. (#FF5733)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FF5733")
        k = 3
        highlights = VGroup(*[SurroundingRectangle(coeffs[i], color="#FF5733") for i in range(0, 8, k)])
        self.play(Create(highlights))
        self.play(Flash(highlights, color="#FF5733", flash_radius=0.3))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Show zeroing out of non-matching coefficients. (#FF33A8)
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF33A8")
        zeroing = VGroup()
        for i in range(8):
            if i % k != 0:
                zeroing.add(coeffs[i])
        
        self.play(FadeOut(zeroing, shift=DOWN*0.5))
        self.play(FadeOut(highlights))

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("The Roots of Unity Filter Lemma", [
            "Consider the n-th roots of unity.",
            "Sum their powers: 1/n times the sum.",
            "Cancel all terms except where n divides k."
        ])

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Visualize roots of unity on complex plane. (#00FF00)
        circle = Circle(radius=1.5, color=WHITE)
        axes = Axes(x_range=[-2, 2], y_range=[-2, 2], axis_config={"include_tip": False})
        roots = [np.exp(2j * PI * k / 4) for k in range(4)]
        dots = VGroup(*[Dot(axes.c2p(r.real, r.imag), color="#00FF00") for r in roots])
        
        root_group = VGroup(circle, axes, dots)
        self.place_in_area(root_group, "A1", "F6", scale_factor=0.6)
        
        self.play(Create(circle), Create(axes))
        self.play(FadeIn(dots))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#00FF00")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Animate summation over roots of unity. (#FFFF00)
        vectors = VGroup(*[Arrow(start=ORIGIN, end=dots[i].get_center(), color="#FFFF00", buff=0) for i in range(4)])
        self.play(Create(vectors))
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FFFF00")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Show destructive interference canceling unwanted terms. (#FF00FF)
        self.play(FadeOut(vectors))
        # Visualizing cancellation
        cancellation = Text("Sum = 0", color="#FF00FF").scale(0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(cancellation, "C3")
        
        self.play(Write(cancellation))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF00FF")
        self.wait(2)

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Step-by-Step Implementation", [
            "Define your generating function P(x).",
            "Evaluate P(x) at each root.",
            "Sum values and divide by n."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Write the generating function P(x) = sum a_i * x^i. (#FFFFFF)
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFFFFF")
        p_x = MathTex("P(x) = \\sum a_i x^i", font_size=36)
        self.place_at_grid(p_x, 'B3')
        self.play(Write(p_x))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Show P(x) evaluated at each root of unity on the complex plane [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg]. (#00FFFF)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#00FFFF")
        plane = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg")
        self.place_at_grid(plane, 'D3', scale_factor=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(plane))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Display the final average calculation: (1/n) * sum P(w^j). (#00FF00)
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#00FF00")
        calc = MathTex("\\frac{1}{n} \\sum P(\\omega^j)", font_size=36)
        self.place_at_grid(calc, 'E3')
        self.play(Write(calc))
        self.wait(2)

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Geometric cancellation is powerful.",
            "Complex filters solve combinatorial problems easily.",
            "Visual intuition leads to algebraic solutions."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Summary and Geometric Intuition", lecture_lines)
        
        # --- Visual Objects ---
        # 1. Circle representing the complex plane
        circle = Circle(radius=1.5, color=BLUE)
        dot = Dot(circle.point_from_proportion(0), color=WHITE)
        vector = Line(ORIGIN, dot.get_center(), color=WHITE)
        
        # 2. Projection objects
        basis_line = Line(LEFT*2, RIGHT*2, color=GRAY)
        
        # 3. Final Signal
        signal = VGroup(*[Square(side_length=0.3, fill_opacity=0.5, color=WHITE) for _ in range(5)])
        signal.arrange(RIGHT)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FF8800"))
        self.place_at_grid(circle, 'C3', 0.8)
        self.play(Create(circle))
        
        # Rotation animation
        self.play(Create(vector), Create(dot))
        self.play(Rotate(vector, angle=TAU, about_point=ORIGIN), Rotate(dot, angle=TAU, about_point=ORIGIN), run_time=3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FFFF00"))
        self.place_at_grid(basis_line, 'E3', 1.0)
        self.play(Create(basis_line))
        # Project dot onto basis
        proj_dot = Dot(color="#FFFF00")
        proj_dot.add_updater(lambda m: m.move_to([dot.get_center()[0], basis_line.get_center()[1], 0]))
        self.add(proj_dot)
        self.play(FadeIn(proj_dot))
        self.play(FadeOut(proj_dot), FadeOut(basis_line))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"))
        self.place_at_grid(signal, 'C3', 1.0)
        self.play(FadeIn(signal))
        self.play(signal.animate.set_color("#00FF00"), run_time=2)
        
        self.wait(2)

outline.topic: The Magic of Roots of Unity: Using Complex Numbers in Combinatorics
outline.target_audience: University students majoring in Mathematics or Computer Science

sections.title: The Root Problem: Filtering Coefficients
sections.content: Introduce the challenge of finding the sum of every k-th coefficient in a generating function P(x). Use the visual concept of a 'filter' that eliminates unwanted terms. Prerequisites: Euler’s Formula (e^ix = cos x + i sin x) and the definition of the n-th roots of unity (ω^k).
sections.example: A squirrel gathering nuts in piles of size 0, 3, 6... how to sum coefficients of x^3k in (1+x)^n.

sections.title: The Roots of Unity Filter Lemma
sections.content: Explain the identity: 1/n * Σ (ω^j)^k = 1 if n divides k, and 0 otherwise. Visualize this as a 'rotating vector sum' in the complex plane where vectors cancel out unless they align at the origin.
sections.example: Visualize the 4th roots of unity (1, i, -1, -i) as points on a unit circle. Show how their sum equals zero, acting as a perfect zero-balance scale.

sections.title: Step-by-Step Implementation
sections.content: Demonstrate the procedure: 1. Identify the generating function P(x). 2. Evaluate P(x) at ω^j. 3. Average the results: 1/n * Σ P(ω^j). Use a flow-chart animation to move from the function to the complex evaluation.
sections.example: Calculating the sum of binomial coefficients Σ C(n, 3k) by evaluating (1+ω^j)^n for the 3rd roots of unity.

sections.title: Summary and Geometric Intuition
sections.content: Conclude by mapping the algebraic result back to the complex plane. Highlight that complex numbers transform a 'picking' operation into a 'geometric cancellation' operation. Quick recap of the 5-minute flow.
sections.example: Final slide showing a 'Robot Collector' selecting every 4th item from a conveyor belt by applying a complex filter.
